holdout_card.fact_statement: Landgericht Aschaffenburg imposed involuntary commitment on the perpetrator on 30 October 2025.
holdout_card.source_span: On 30 October 2025, after a six-day trial, Landgericht Aschaffenburg imposed involuntary commitment to a psychiatric institution.

qa_variants.question: On what date did the Landgericht Aschaffenburg impose involuntary commitment on the perpetrator of the 2025 Aschaffenburg stabbing attack?
qa_variants.source_span: On 30 October 2025, after a six-day trial, Landgericht Aschaffenburg imposed involuntary commitment to a psychiatric institution.
